title: Members panel
responsibility: Lists project members and exposes invitations to owners.

inputs.name: MembersPanel.projectId
inputs.description: Required project identifier used for project and member reads on mount and passed to the owner invitation form. Prop changes do not independently trigger another load.

outputs.name: MembersPanel
outputs.description: Members heading and table of names, emails and roles once the project is loaded. Empty lists are explicitly labeled. Owners see an invitation form; others see an owner-only explanation. Read failures are alerts.
